obfuscation_indicators: many of which are beyond our control
risk_summary: The excerpt contains extensive legal safe-h harbor language and a broad, largely non-quantified catalog of potential risks, including leverage, contract, liability, pension, cybersecurity, and divestiture exposures. It also provides some concrete disclosure, including the pension deficit reduction and remaining share-repurchase authorization, but the risk section is highly boilerplate and difficult to prioritize.
